exposure: category of cesarean section indication (1, 2, or 3)
timing of cesarean section (during or outside of working hours)
outcome: neonatal outcomes (Apgar score, NICU admission, length of stay in NICU)
cohort: 189 patients who underwent emergency cesarean sections
finding: The study found that while there was no difference in D-I interval for category 1 cesarean sections performed during or outside of working hours, category 2 cesareans were delayed during working hours, but there were no differences in neonatal outcomes between the groups.
birth_weight: Measured but not specified in abstract
